comparison.objective: Extract a rover from beneath a collapsed slab without destabilizing it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained extraction and rubble-contact management versus small-tool insertion, adjustment and lock-torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Rover reaches the pad while slab remains stable versus two repeatable safe carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Load-stability-aware extraction is unrelated to tuning an impact absorber. No quantitative slab-motion or damage rubric is supplied.
